params.name: id
params.description: A transaction identifier. This may be a 64-character hex-encoded transaction ID (e.g. `a1b2c3...`) or a uint64 scheduled transaction ID returned by the system contract.

params.name: block_id
params.description: A block ID optional parameter

params.name: collection_id
params.description: A collection ID optional parameter.

params.name: expand
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to expand.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to return.

items.docs: Get a transaction data by the provided transaction ID. If the transaction is a scheduled transaction, it can alternatively be retrieved by the scheduled transaction ID field returned by the system contract.

params.name: block_id
params.description: The ID of the block containing the transactions. The request may include either `block_id` or `block_height`, but not both.

params.name: block_height
params.description: The height of the block containing the transactions. The request may include either `block_id` or `block_height`, but not both.

params.name: expand
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to expand.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to return.

params.name: agreeing_executors_count
params.description: A minimum number of execution receipts for the execution result.

params.name: required_executor_ids
params.description: A set of execution node IDs, one of which must have produced the execution result.

params.name: include_executor_metadata
params.description: Specifies whether or not to include the executor metadata in the response.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of transaction results for a specific block. This includes results for submitted, system, and scheduled transactions.
